mapper.select: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(expiry_date, CURDATE()) <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as expired_count, SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(expiry_date, CURDATE()) BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as soon_expire_count, SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(expiry_date, CURDATE()) BETWEEN 31 AND 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as near_expire_count, SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(expiry_date, CURDATE()) > 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as normal_count, COUNT(*) as total_count FROM spd_stock WHERE del_flag = 0 AND expiry_date IS NOT NULL
